[Verse 1]
[G]On bended knee is no
[Bm]way to be free
[G7]Lifting up an empty cup, I
[C/E]ask silently
[C]All my destinations will ac-
[G]cept the one that's me So
[D]I can breathe

[Verse 2]
[G]Circles they grow and they
[Bm]swallow people whole
[G7]Half their lives they say goodnight to
[C/E]wives they'll never know A
[C]mind full of questions, and a
[G]teacher in my soul And
[D]so it goes

[Verse 3]
[G]Don't come closer or
[Bm]I'll have to go
[G7]Holding me like gravity are
[C/E]places that pull
[C]If ever there was someone to
[G]keep me at home It
[D]would be you

[Verse 4]
[G]Everyone I come across, in
[Bm]cages they bought They
[G7]think of me and my wandering, but I'm
[C/E]never what they thought I've
[C]got my indignation, but I'm
[G]pure in all my thoughts
[D]I'm alive

[Verse 4]
[G]Wind in my hair, I feel
[Bm]part of everywhere
[G7]Underneath my being is a
[C/E]road that disappeared
[C]Late at night I hear the trees, they're
[G]singing with the dead
[D]Overhead

[Verse 5]
[G]Leave it to me as I
[Bm]find away to be Con-
[G7]sider me a satellite, for-
[C/E]ever orbiting
[C]I knew all the rules, but the rules
[G]did not know me G-
[D]uaranteed
